verdict.rationale: Scraped data is clearly portable: datasets can be exported to CSV, JSON, XLSX or XML and loaded straight into Pandas. Code portability is implied by Docker-based Actors and the open-source Crawlee library, and task configurations are stored on the platform and reachable through the API/OpenAPI, but there is no documented way to export job configurations (tasks, schedules) for migration elsewhere. Missing for 10: documented export of task/schedule configurations, explicit anti-lock-in or migration-out guidance, independent corroboration of migrating off Apify.
